done_when: forge sync deletes CLAUDE.md when every non-empty line of it, apart from an @AGENTS.md import and Forge's old block, is already in AGENTS.md, so a CLAUDE.md whose lines moved to AGENTS.md doesn't duplicate them; a CLAUDE.md with any line of its own stays, keeping an @AGENTS.md line as today. Command-level tests cover an adopted repo whose CLAUDE.md lines all moved (CLAUDE.md removed) and one with an extra line (kept with the import).
why: Adopting a repo with its own CLAUDE.md copies the team's lines into AGENTS.md but leaves them in CLAUDE.md and adds an @AGENTS.md import, so Claude Code reads every line twice
